title: American Ex Navy man finds his Japanese first love after 70 years
summary_full: After a heart-wrenching separation of nearly seventy years, Duane Mann and Peggy Yamaguchi finally found each other again. Believing his savings vanished and letters silenced, Mann discovered his mother had hidden their correspondence by burning Peggy's letters. Tragically, Peggy had endured the loss of their child and moved on with another. Their reunion brought long-awaited closure, reaffirming the deep bond and affection that still lingered between them.
